branding_brief.brand_objective: Establish a coherent visual identity for `acme-bootstrapped` aligned with the current campaign positioning.
branding_brief.target_audience: Fundadores de SaaS bootstrapped en LATAM, equipos de 1-5 personas, sin capital... | Pain points: Falta de tiempo, Sobrecarga informativa | Desired outcomes: Lograr qualified trials
branding_brief.positioning_statement: Acme Pro: equipos para resolver falta de tiempo.

typography_principles: Jerarquía clara: headline > subhead > body > CTA.
do_use: Fotografía editorial con personas reales del público.
Paleta sobria con un acento sharp.
do_not_use: Caras simétricas con manos deformes (IA sin curar).

constraints: Inherit the campaign visual tone from the visual pack when present.
Do not introduce colours or fonts that contradict the approved creative.
acceptance_criteria: Logo works on light + dark + monochrome backgrounds.
Palette passes WCAG AA contrast for body text.
Typography system covers display + body + UI scales.
Voice guide produces 3 sample microcopy pieces matching the campaign tone.
